featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a Livpure water purifier that developed an electrical issue in the second half of the year—the pump would cut off after a few seconds. The issue would conveniently resolve itself before each service visit, making it hard to demonstrate the problem. Finally, I captured the issue on video and shared it with the assigned Livpure technician.

Unfortunately, my experience with Livpure's service was extremely frustrating. The technician would repeatedly reschedule appointments, asking for the closure code without resolving the issue. On multiple occasions, he failed to show up or respond to calls, leaving me without water for five days. This lack of professionalism and accountability was unacceptable.

Desperate for a solution, I reached out to Binod to fix my Livpure machine. Although he couldn't fully resolve the issue due to the complexities involved, Binod went above and beyond to help me. Understanding my situation, he recommended a new machine from another brand and ensured it was installed promptly. To my surprise, the new purifier performed significantly better than Livpure, with excellent output and reliability.

Binod's dedication, professionalism, and willingness to assist, even in such a challenging situation, deserve five stars. Thank you, Binod, for turning a frustrating experience into a positive outcome! Highly recommend his services.
